# Poorly Drawn Swords

---

## Unique Art Style
Ever wanted your swords to look like they were drawn by someone who has never seen a sword before? Now they can!

Tired of those realistic texture packs? Then welcome to **Poorly Drawn Swords**, the only pack where the bad looks are the best part! This pack replaces every single sword texture, drawn by **me**.
